checked: ICC Docket 22-B interlocutory order of July 7, 1966 (OSU id 1062): on May 29, 1873, the date of the executive order, the United States acquired the Indian title to the Mescalero aboriginal lands in Finding No. 37 without payment of compensation; value to be fixed as of that date, confirmed Spanish and Mexican grants excluded. Status broken rests on the 1966 contested finding, a claims-commission breach, not on the settlement.
